    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    AboutPanel
    Panel that displays information about the application, including author details, used resources, repository link, and the application logo.
    DownloadedFile
    Represents a media file stored locally on disk.
    DownloadPanel
    Panel responsible for managing video and audio downloads using yt-dlp.
    LibraryIconRenderer
    Custom cell renderer for the Library JTable that replaces text values with icons that represent, the media type and the media origin.
    LibraryItem
    Represents an unified media entry in the library, combining cloud media and local file.
    LibraryPanel
    Panel that displays and manages the user's media library, combining both local files stored on disk and cloud media synchronized through the application's backend services.
    LibraryTableModel
    Table model used to display a list of LibraryItem objects inside the LibraryPanel JTable.
    LoginPanel
    Panel responsible for handling user authentication within the application.
    MainWindow
    Main class that extends JFrame.
    Preferences
    Panel that manages all user-configurable application settings.
